page.layout: Top centre: two round engraved medallions side by side, the left with the legend SER. GALBA IMP. SAES AVG., the right with LEPIDA GALBAE IMP VXOR. Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs (the first a biography of Galba, the second about Lepida). No margin notes, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: SERGIVS Sulpitius Galba, Romæ post Neronē imperat anno mundi 4030. à Christo nato 68. Hic nullo gradu Cæsares contingebat, nam horum familia, siue progenies in Neronē defecerat: nobilissimus tamen erat, magnáq; & vetere prosapia. Antequàm imperaret mula fertur peperisse. Hic cùm Prætor esset, elephantos funambulos edidit ludis Floralibus. Maiore ab initio fauore quàm læto successu, septimestre imperium tenuit annos natus circiter 80. priuata eius vita insignis fuerat militaribus & ciuilibus rebus. Tandem auarum, sæuum, pigrum se præstitit: atque inuisus omnibus, in medio foro, insidiis Othonis iugulatur: nam cùm subinde iactaret se legere militem, uon emere consuesse, eo nomine omnes milites exacerbauit. Sed maximè fremebat superioris Germaniæ exercitus fraudari se præmiis: quare statim legationem ad prætorianos cum mandatis destinant: displicere inquiunt Imperatorem in Hispania factum, eligerent ipsi quem cuncti exercitus probarent. Quamobrem ascitus Otho eum trucidari curauit. Vide Sueto.in Galba, Eutro.lib.7. Bap.Egna.lib.1.

LEPIDA vxor fuit Galbæ Imperatoris, qua amissa, duobúsque ex ea filiis, remansit in cœlibatu: neque solicitari vlla conditione amplius potuit, ne Agrippinæ quidem matris Neronis, viduatæ morte Domitij Aenobarbi, quæ maritum quoq; adhuc, necdum cœlibem Galbam, adeò omnibus solicitauerat modis, vt in conuentu matronarum correpta iurgio, atq; etiam manu pullata sit à matre Lepidæ. Sueto.in Gal.

page.notes: Coin legends are read from the engraving; "SAES" on the left medallion is doubtful. "uon" in "uon emere" is printed as such (probably for non) and is left as printed. "consuesse" is read from a worn "confuesse"; check against the scan. Paragraph 2 is set in a heavier face than paragraph 1, but no italics are used. The small mark near the lower margin is a stain and not transcribed.
